question: Should the official memory-lancedb plugin grow built-in BM25 plus vector hybrid retrieval now, or should advanced LanceDB hybrid/rerank behavior remain external or ClawHub-owned?
rationale: The capability is source-verifiably missing and feasible in the plugin, but it changes official retrieval semantics, config/defaults, persistent FTS indexing, and fallback policy that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
options.body: Add memory-lancedb-owned hybrid mode with FTS indexing, explicit config/defaults, vector fallback behavior, docs, and regression tests.

options.title: Defer advanced retrieval externally
options.body: Keep official memory-lancedb vector-only and document advanced LanceDB hybrid/rerank behavior as a community package or ClawHub path.

options.title: Keep vector-only by design
options.body: Close the direction after documenting that memory-lancedb is a vector backend while memory-core owns hybrid retrieval.

recommendation.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
recommendation.body: Add memory-lancedb-owned hybrid mode with FTS indexing, explicit config/defaults, vector fallback behavior, docs, and regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from memory-lancedb history, memory-engine refactors, and prior review context on this issue.
